picks.title: Fusion energy poised for simpler U.S. review
picks.why_it_matters: Simplified federal permitting for fusion could accelerate commercialization timelines and make fusion startups significantly more attractive investment opportunities.

picks.title: Maka Kids is redefining kids' screen time with a streaming app optimized for well-being, not engagement
picks.why_it_matters: A $3M seed round signals investor appetite for children's digital wellness—a category poised to grow as parents and regulators push back against engagement-maximizing algorithms.

picks.title: Convective Capital raises an $85 million fund to build disaster resilience
picks.why_it_matters: New dedicated capital for climate resilience tech validates the category and signals co-investment opportunities for early-stage VCs backing startups in fire, flood, and disaster response.
